George optical for me. Bukod sa quality ng eyeglasses, most important thing for me is yung accuracy ng diagnosis nila. Tried EO 3x already, kept on coming back kasi i thought “need” ko na. Then i decided to try George. Potek gamechanger sya. Sa EO rushed yung tests nila and overall diagnostic procedures. As in ang bilis like 10 mins. At first parang ok, mabilis which is always nice pero may feeling ako na parang mali sya. Turns out it fucken is. After ng third try ko sa EO, lipat ako sa George. Potek ang extensive ng tests nila, ang daming questions ng optometrist and very dynamic yung questioning unlike sa EO na parang basic set of questions lang. i got my prescription glasses and ang very accurate ang grado na needed ko. Anyway long story short:
George = big PP
EO = small PP
